platform.gives[0].en: claude agents --json, with a machine status computed by the harness rather than by the model

platform.gives[1].en: A per-user supervisor process that restarts a crashed session, with three safety catches

platform.gives[2].en: Standard states Working / Needs input / Idle / Completed / Failed / Stopped — a ready-made indicator for “the orchestrator is blocked on a question”

platform.gives[3].en: Hidden but working subcommands: claude attach / logs / stop / respawn / rm / daemon

platform.gives[4].en: A machine going to sleep is survivable; the supervisor reconnects on wake

platform.gives[5].en: Desktop scheduled tasks: a 1-minute minimum, a catch-up run after sleep, learnable permissions, and a history that records why a run was skipped

platform.gives[6].en: --max-budget-usd for -p — a first-class spending ceiling, which we use nowhere

platform.gives[7].en: claude setup-token — long-lived authentication on the subscription

platform.gives[8].en: Channels — event push into a live session, plus permission relay

platform.does_not_give[0].en: The supervisor is not a permanent service: “Service install is disabled in this version — the daemon runs on demand and exits when the last client disconnects”. There is nobody to restart the thing that does the restarting

platform.does_not_give[1].en: A machine shutdown is not survivable: sessions become failed and require a human

platform.does_not_give[2].en: The supervisor restarts a process, not the work: it has no concept of “context is running out”, “write a handoff before you die”, “a legitimate pause on a quota limit”, or “the cycle counter has not moved for 60 hours”

platform.does_not_give[3].en: Our topology is not covered: teammate workers living in tmux panes do not appear in claude agents --json at all

platform.does_not_give[4].en: /loop and session-scoped cron cannot resurrect a dead session

platform.devalues_our_code[0].how.en: It obtains by hand three things the platform now hands over: is the process alive, is it busy, how do you restart it. And that home-made part is exactly the part that turned out to be misconfigured. The conclusion is to narrow it, not throw it away: roughly half the code, and the remaining half more reliable.

platform.devalues_our_code[1].what.en: The “Spawn mechanics” section in the skill's reference files

platform.devalues_our_code[1].how.en: Devalued completely: TeamCreate and run_in_background do not exist. This is not “half a step out of date”, it is dead code inside an instruction.

platform.devalues_our_code[2].what.en: The skill's entire economics of pulse cadence

platform.devalues_our_code[2].how.en: It was calculated against a five-minute prompt-cache TTL; the TTL is now an hour, and the planning tool's own documentation says explicitly not to think in cache windows. The skill's central prohibition rests on physics that has vanished — and it is precisely that prohibition which contradicts your rule about the pulse.

platform.devalues_our_code[3].what.en: The idea of an LLM supervisor built on claude -p

platform.devalues_our_code[3].how.en: The standard supervisor does the restarting itself, and polling costs about $48 a night. The one correct role for -p is a rare, one-off judgement after the mechanical layer has already found an anomaly.

borrowings[0].what.en: Risk tiers 0/1/2 for gates, with a TTL and a per-category floor enforced in code

borrowings[0].why.en: Money, public communications, secrets and destructive actions are forced down into tier 2 — not by trusting the caller, but enforced in code

borrowings[1].what.en: Learning from ask_shape precedents, with an advisory-only invariant

borrowings[1].why.en: A precedent fills in what the recommendation means, but never changes the tier; auto-clear reads only an exact match, never a fuzzy one

borrowings[2].what.en: The recovery ladder detect → classify → act → escalate, biased towards false negatives

borrowings[2].why.en: Three classes healthy/slow/stuck, with “do nothing” prescribed for slow. We have no slow class at all

borrowings[3].what.en: RestartBudget: a sliding window plus exponential backoff, then give up and escalate outward

borrowings[3].why.en: An orchestrator that crashes right after starting is not woken all night; in the morning you get one coherent escalation instead of a hundred

borrowings[4].why.en: What is observed outranks what is recorded: “tmux alive + recorded as a zombie → investigate, do not kill”

borrowings[5].why.en: One number instead of six hours that never reconcile; the data already exists

borrowings[6].what.en: The principle “1 nudge = 1 task”; do not wake anything if there are no tasks

borrowings[6].why.en: Zero token spend, and it does not open a five-hour quota window

borrowings[7].what.en: A reaper and a starvation detector

borrowings[7].why.en: A reaped task returns to todo rather than being cancelled; a task nudged three times surfaces

borrowings[8].what.en: Parking with a mandatory wake-up date

borrowings[8].why.en: “A park with no revisit date is the block graveyard”

borrowings[9].what.en: An explicit string completion sentinel plus an iteration ceiling

borrowings[9].why.en: Our loop exit is the model's judgement; a sentinel makes it machine-checkable

borrowings[10].what.en: A persistent per-step visit counter (step_visits, cap)

borrowings[10].why.en: It survives a change of orchestrator — unlike our breaker, which lived in the LLM's memory

borrowings[11].what.en: Mobile as a second presentation of the same store

borrowings[11].why.en: Apply it now, while mobile is frozen, so that it does not become a second product later

our_strengths_to_preserve[0].en: A decision manifest with cited provenance — none of the four rivals has this

our_strengths_to_preserve[1].en: The Jira + GitHub pairing as an external source of truth

our_strengths_to_preserve[2].en: Positive identification of the pane in the watchdog, and proper handling of quiesce modes

our_strengths_to_preserve[3].en: Verification through separate EN+RU HTML acceptance dashboards

our_strengths_to_preserve[4].en: The discipline that missing data is never drawn as a zero: unknown with a reason, a verdict that can only get worse, every screen printing its own glob, and a filter obliged to say what it hid
